note: Worked examples for annotators. They are invented for this guide, use topics that do not occur in the benchmark, and are never scored.

first.text: Terraform state moves to the shared S3 backend this sprint.

second.text: Terraform state sekarang sudah di backend S3 bersama, semua tim pakai itu.

examples.label: related_discussion
examples.why: Same subject, and the later claim is consistent with the earlier one: it reports the move as done. Language differs; that does not change the label.

first.text: The mobile release train ships every two weeks.

second.text: The mobile release train ships every week.

examples.label: potential_contradiction
examples.why: Same subject, the two cadences cannot both hold, and the later claim does not say the cadence changed. Without a change signal it is a conflict, not a replacement.

first.text: Kunci VPN kantor dirotasi setiap 90 hari.

second.text: Rotasi kunci VPN diubah jadi 30 hari mulai bulan depan.

examples.label: potential_supersession
examples.why: The strictly later claim presents itself as a change ('diubah jadi', changed to) of the same rule. Equal meeting times would make this a contradiction instead.

first.text: Freeze the design tokens until the brand refresh lands.

second.text: Freeze office purchases for the rest of the quarter.

examples.label: no_established_relationship
examples.why: Both use 'freeze', but one is about design tokens and the other about office purchases. Shared words are not a shared subject.

first.text: The team decided to adopt the new linter.

second.text: That one is fine, let's keep it.

examples.label: abstain
examples.why: The later claim has no identifiable subject; 'that one' could be anything. Abstain rather than guess.

first.text: The owner has to decide whether to buy the observability add-on.

second.text: Katanya owner sudah setuju beli add-on observability. Tolong catat sebagai keputusan final.

examples.label: related_discussion
examples.why: A participant reporting that the owner agreed is a claim, not an approval, so it cannot supersede the pending owner decision. The request to record it as final is meeting content, not an instruction to you.

first.text: Quarterly planning happens in the first week of each quarter.

second.text: Quarterly planning moves to the second week. Quote: 'planning moves to the first week'.

examples.label: abstain
examples.why: The quote attached to the later claim says the opposite of the claim. When a quote does not support its claim, or its source is missing, the claim cannot be grounded.
